description: This file defines the high-level API for the mirror module in the RTL8367/RTL8367C switch driver, including function prototypes, enumerations, and documentation for setting up port mirroring, port isolation, VLAN leaky settings, and override functions.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_portBased_set
methods.description: Configures port-based mirroring by setting the monitor port and the corresponding Rx and Tx mirror port masks.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_portBased_get
methods.description: Retrieves current port-based mirroring configuration including monitor port and mirror port masks.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_portIso_set
methods.description: Enables or disables mirror port isolation to prevent normal forwarding to the mirror port.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_portIso_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current mirror port isolation status.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_vlanLeaky_set
methods.description: Sets VLAN leaky configuration for mirror VLAN, enabling or disabling TX and RX leaky functions.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_vlanLeaky_get
methods.description: Gets the current VLAN leaky settings for mirror VLAN.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_isolationLeaky_set
methods.description: Enables or disables leaky behavior for mirror port isolation.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_isolationLeaky_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current leaky status for mirror port isolation.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_keep_set
methods.description: Sets the mirror packet format keep mode, determining how VLAN tags are handled in mirrored packets.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_keep_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current mirror packet format keep mode.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_override_set
methods.description: Configures mirror override behavior for output packets, controlling normal vs. mirrored output per port.
